'''Carlos Eduardo "Edu" Peppe Britos''' (born 28 January 1983) is an [[Uruguay]]an-born [[Andorra]]n international [[association football|footballer]] who plays for [[UE Sant Julià]] in [[Primera Divisió]], as a [[midfielder]]. Besides Uruguay, he has played in Andorra.<ref>[https://www.elobservador.com.uy/nota/mediocampista-y-mozo-de-hotel-201212615480 Interview with Carlos Peppe] elobservador.com.uy</ref>

==Career==
Peppe began his senior career at [[Defensor Sporting]] in 2002, moving to [[Club Sportivo Cerrito|Cerrito]] in 2005. He signed for [[UE Sant Julià|Sant Julià]] in 2007.

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2011.
